searchText: I was reviewing the EIP-8141 PR in EELS and found out that `APPROVE` still works under `STATICCALL`, which might seem obvious since the EIP treats `APPROVE` as exemptible from this flag, but I feel that breaks the assumption that nothing can be modified under `STATICCALL`, doesn't it? Can we confirm these are in `bogota-devnet-2` (includes the max fee change, I believe this was agreed on ACDE at the end)? EIP-7906 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12516 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12528 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12530 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12554 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12555 EIP-8141 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12414 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12502 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12569 EIP-8250 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12511 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12534 And can we close these, (sorry for the @'s) then all the `bogota-devnet-1` EIPs are aligned? EIP-7906 (<@703301497194152108>) - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10899 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10972 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11072 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11199 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11267 ~~EIP-8250 - https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12467 <@792404665068158998>~~ LGTM Follow up to the `max_fee` change, `GASPRICE` can no longer be exact: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12569 ah thanks, i totally forgot to add this

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: I was reviewing the EIP-8141 PR in EELS and found out that `APPROVE` still works under `STATICCALL`, which might seem obvious since the EIP treats `APPROVE` as exemptible from this flag, but I feel that breaks the assumption that nothing can be modified under `STATICCALL`, doesn't it?
